observed: During a passive tablet height transition to 240dp the host editor can lose focus. Without explicit reselection it did not regain focus after restoring 800dp. Explicitly selecting the editor before input kept focus through actual input, Ctrl+S save and height restoration in the corrected scenario.
scope: Host observation only; device behavior and presence before this change have not been established.
cause: The panel can temporarily resolve full-height while its old child size is still present; exact cause requires follow-up.
retained: Buffer/file identities, text, actual disk save, caption, panel choice and selected session model are asserted. The short-input scenario explicitly requests editor focus to model user selection, then asserts focus after height restoration; floating and boundary paths still assert focus.
disposition: Recorded for later investigation per user UI-first instruction. No additional production focus or terminal behavior change in this batch.
